title: Change plural demonstrative statements into negatives
summary: Replace ovat with eivät ole and keep the supplied plural demonstrative subject and context.
objectives: Replace ovat with eivät ole and keep the supplied plural demonstrative subject and context.
Apply the pattern using the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: Change the polarity only
paragraphs: Replace ovat with eivät ole and keep the supplied plural demonstrative subject and context.
Read both meanings. Keep the complete subject, including the noun, unchanged.

examples.finnish: Nämä kirjat ovat kotona. → Nämä kirjat eivät ole kotona.
examples.english: These books are at home. → These books are not at home.
steps: Nämä kirjat: the complete plural subject is supplied.
ole: fixed form after the negative verb.

commonMistakes: Do not change the supplied demonstrative or noun.
Keep ole after the negative verb.

practiceExercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order.
